chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb narrated from Ibrāhīm ibn Maymūn, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who becomes junub at night in the Month of Ramadan, then forgets to perform ghusl until a week passes for that, or the Month of Ramadan ends.
He said: “He is liable for the make-up of the salat and the sawm.”

key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the Month of Ramadan, during which fasting is obligatory
key_terms.قَضَاءُ: make-up performance of missed obligatory acts
key_terms.يَغْتَسِلَ: to perform ghusl, the ritual bath

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on someone who forgets ghusl after janabah during Ramadan until days pass or the month ends?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who remains in janabah during Ramadan due to forgetfulness and does not perform ghusl for an extended period. The Imam عليه السلام rules that such a person must make up both the prayers and the fasts affected by that state.
